query: What is the effect of military-experienced board directors on accrual-based earnings management in Pakistan-listed non-financial firms (2010–2022)?

response.query: What is the effect of military-experienced board directors on accrual-based earnings management in Pakistan-listed non-financial firms (2010–2022)?
response.answer: Military-experienced board directors tend to reduce accrual-based earnings management in Pakistan-listed non-financial firms. This effect is attributed to their strategic oversight and discipline. Research shows a significant correlation between military experience and improved financial reporting integrity.
